topic: Someone discovers their partner has been writing a novel about them
text: I found the book tucked away in a corner of the attic, its cover worn and familiar, like a secret I've always known. Every page was a letter to me, a story spun from the threads of our days together. It’s as if each word was a gentle reminder of the moments we've shared, whispered softly in the quiet hours of night. The characters that mirrored us navigated through landscapes that felt like home, their journey a mirror to our own. I traced the lines with my fingers, feeling each story beat in my chest. It’s an adventure, this life we've crafted, and to find it captured in such a way—it’s nothing short of a gift.
